authority: owner watched the doctrine-v5 gallery headliner: the ghost camping the top-right vicinity for a hundred-plus ticks while its task leases churned - a single-unit park invisible to the team-level statue and dance bars, and the second time a parked ghost reached a curated gallery
purpose: Cohort, ladder, and gallery eligibility, not an outcome or fun score

pickupDropCycle.episodeIdentity: same Core, same carrier life, and same tile
pickupDropCycle.resetEvents: bank, handoff, relocation, birth, a different carrier or tile, or a gap above the configured maximum

homeCarrierNonProgress.ownershipScope: same-team continuous carried possession; an allied handoff does not reset the run
homeCarrierNonProgress.progressDefinition: strictly lower static eight-way walkable distance to the owning team's reactor
homeCarrierNonProgress.contestDisposition: ticks with an enemy within the configured distance pause but do not reset the run

eligibility: A doctrine or sheet side that trips pickup-drop cycling, ping-pong, off-theater passivity, formation freeze, stuck-carrier, or uncontested home-carrier non-progress bars is excluded from cohort reads, ladders, and galleries until fixed; exclusions are disclosed.

teamStatue.frozenDefinition: a live body whose position is unchanged for the whole window, regardless of the actions it issues; the team trips when at least minimumFrozenBodies and at least the configured share of its live bodies are simultaneously frozen

teamDance.confinedDefinition: a live body that never leaves the Chebyshev radius around its reference tile for the whole window (the reference resets whenever it steps outside); statues are radius-0 dancers, so this subsumes teamStatue, which remains for continuity

unitParked.rationale: One unit camping a 5x5 area for 120+ ticks reads as a bug on replay however healthy the rest of the team looks - the owner caught exactly this twice before it became a bar. Heal channels finish in ~15 ticks and ambush perches relocate within ~32 under the tactical mind's no-idle invariant, so nothing intended survives this window.
